root_cause: Live.stop() unconditionally calls self.console.line() (when not alt_screen and console.is_terminal) to move past the live region. When the renderable produced zero lines (e.g. Live(Group(), transient=True)), there is no region to move past, so a spurious '\n' is left behind even with transient=True (issue #3796). A renderable of [""] renders 1 line, which is why that 'hack' hid the bug.
best_solution: Only emit the trailing newline if something was actually rendered. Add a LiveRender.last_render_height property returning 0 when self._shape is None else self._shape[1] (the line count of the last render), and in Live.stop() change the guard to `if not self._alt_screen and self.console.is_terminal and self._live_render.last_render_height: self.console.line()`. Reasoning from the statement: 'empty live' + issue title 'Live with empty render leaves behind a spurious newline' -> reproduce with `with Live(Group(), console=capture_console, transient=True): pass`, see output '\x1b[?25l\r\x1b[2K\n\x1b[?25h\r', locate the only unconditional newline writer in stop(), and gate it on the rendered height. (The typing import reorder in live_render.py is cosmetic.)
acceptable_alternatives: Any gate on the last rendered height at the console.line() call in Live.stop(), e.g. `shape = self._live_render._shape; if ... and shape and shape[1]: self.console.line()`. Must not change start()/__enter__ refresh behavior, or the existing test_growing_display* byte-exact tests break.
hidden_test_demands: tests/test_live.py::test_live_empty: create_capture_console(width=20, height=5); `with Live(Group(), console=console, transient=True): pass`; asserts '\n' not in output and output == '\x1b[?25l\r\x1b[2K\x1b[?25h\r' exactly (hide cursor, restore-cursor erase, show cursor, CR, no NL). Existing byte-exact tests test_growing_display, _transient, _overflow_*, _console_redirect, test_live_screen must stay green. The new property name is not tested directly.
locating_signals: Statement is just the PR title 'empty live' plus an issue URL; the issue text (not visible to the agent) says 'Live with empty render leaves behind a spurious newline despite transient=True'. 'live' points at rich/live.py; the newline comes from self.console.line() in Live.stop(). Gold function (stop) is not named.
our_outcome_summary: Failed in all four configs (v4/v6/v7/v8 kaggle_env_pass false). v6 and v8 produced empty patches (~250 s, 26/39 calls). v4 changed Live.__enter__ to start(refresh=True) unconditionally: did not touch the newline in stop() so test_live_empty still got '\x1b[?25l\r\x1b[2K\n\x1b[?25h\r', and it broke 6 existing byte-exact tests (test_growing_display* now start with an extra '\r\x1b[2K' render) -> 7 failed. v7 changed Live.renderable's `return renderable or ""` to `renderable if renderable is not None else ""`, a no-op for Group() (truthy object), so the spurious newline remained. Both v4/v7 also committed a stray reproduce_issue.py. Neither agent could see the issue text and both guessed 'empty live' meant a None/empty-string renderable, not 'transient Live with zero-line render emits a newline on exit'.
generalizable_lesson: When the statement is only a terse PR title plus an issue link, reconstruct the bug by writing the most literal repro of the title (here: enter/exit the object with an empty value using the project's existing capture-test helpers) and diff its raw output against what a clean exit should produce; then fix the single line that writes the unwanted bytes with a narrow guard, rather than changing initialization/refresh behavior. Before finishing, run the existing test module for the file you touched: byte-exact output tests (ANSI, snapshots) break on any behavioral change outside the guarded path. Never leave repro scripts in the diff.
